title: 10 tips for effective flyer design - DoxZoo

facts.fact: The article was published on 17 October 2022 and later updated on 4 March 2023.
DoxZoo's site banner offers a 10% discount on a customer's first two orders when they register and save.
facts.quote: REGISTER AND SAVE 10% ON YOUR FIRST 2 ORDERS

facts.fact: According to DoxZoo, professional stock images can be bought on platforms such as Shutterstock and Adobe Stock for under £10.
facts.quote: On platforms like Shutterstock, Adobe Stock etc., you can buy professional images for under £10.

facts.fact: The article states that A5 is a very popular flyer format that is large enough to hold all the information.
facts.quote: A5 is a very popular format, as it is large enough to accommodate all the information and will not easily get lost in the post.

facts.fact: The article defines the AIDA formula as standing for Attention, Interest, Desire, and Action.
facts.quote: AIDA stands for Attention, Interest, Desire, and Action.

facts.fact: The article lists 10 tips for effective flyer design.
The article's stated reading time is 4 minutes.
